events.title: Iran War Day 161 - Strait of Hormuz Closed
events.summary: Active US-Israel-Iran war since Feb 2026. Strait of Hormuz remains closed as of Aug 7. Iran parliament reviewing bill to ban US/Israeli vessels. Houthi threats to Bahrain/UAE. No reopening signed.

events.title: 2026 Ebola Epidemic - DRC/Uganda, WHO PHEIC
events.summary: Bundibugyo virus outbreak in DRC: 3,973 confirmed cases, 1,801 deaths, 674 hospitalized. WHO declared PHEIC on May 16. Spread to Uganda (2 deaths).

events.title: Japan-US-South Korea Trilateral Currency Intervention
events.summary: Rare joint intervention: Japan sold ~$58.97bn to buy yen, coordinated with US Treasury and South Korea. BOJ at 1% rate, accelerating tightening. Won hit 9-month high.

events.title: Gold at $4,350/oz + Oil Shock + Food Crisis Convergence
events.summary: Gold at $4,350 (RED, +28% YoY). Brent crude ~$83-86 after peaking above $100 in July. 49M more facing acute hunger in 2026.

events.title: Fed Chair Warsh Signaling Rate Hike - Inflation Reaccelerating
events.summary: Fed held rates at 3.5-3.75% (9-3 split vote) in July. Chair Warsh emphasizing inflation concerns. Markets pricing in rate hike. Next FOMC Sept 16.
